title: SWMM's "Godbody" is a major record that anyone who loves music can enjoy
htmlContent:
SWMM's "Godbody" is a major record that anyone who loves music can enjoy. The art and magic of music is on full bloom for every second, as each element moved in perfect harmony with the next, to make something beyond words, for a genius level of music.

The sound is big and filled with amazing colors with the waves of the music, taking the listener away. The vocal performance is big time and strong enough to guide the listener, over this amazing record that delivers in every single facet of record making to the fullest.
